dispositions.topic_text: Ownership of creating missing configured binary and state root directories
Ownership of token generation and initial token-file provisioning, including absent-file startup behavior
dispositions.reason: read_token is read-only and a token file that cannot be read ends the start (State 5); the installation provisions the token (A5 rules 2 and 3), so no module creates it.

dispositions.topic_text: Whether the Portal may modify binary-store folders concurrently or after installation
dispositions.reason: Only the Portal and the deliverer write the binary store (A6 rule 1); neither replaces a folder of it with a link, and no text admits such an event.
